pattern.description: The linear pipeline of feature cards lifts into a circular ring that orbits around a growing conic-gradient orb; the orb blooms to fill the ring, swallowing the cards, then contracts into a compact orb widget at centre.
pattern.why_premium: It visualises 'complexity collapses into one product' in a single continuous motion: many parts physically converge into the brand orb, synced to 'but not anymore', with a reverse swoosh landing the collapse.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.card', {motionPath/ring positions via x,y, rotation: 0, duration: 0.8, ease: 'power2.inOut', stagger: 0.04}); tl.to('.ring', {rotation: 90, duration: 1.0, ease: 'none'}, '<'); tl.fromTo('.orb', {scale: 0, filter: 'blur(30px)', autoAlpha: 0}, {scale: 3, filter: 'blur(0px)', autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power2.out'}, '-=0.6'); tl.to('.card', {autoAlpha: 0, scale: 0.6, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.in'}, '<0.3'); tl.to('.orb', {scale: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.inOut'}); orb gradient rotates continuously (conic-gradient angle tween).
build_hint.remotion: Cards: interpolate a ring angle with Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic) and place each at (cos, sin) * radius, offset by i/N; orb scale from spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200}}) up to 3, then a second spring (damping ~20, stiffness ~120) back to 1; orb blur via interpolate; card opacity fades out as orb radius passes them.

notes: End frame shows only the orb; card boxes b03-b08 mark where cards left from (start positions), mapped to cards by x position. Orb role chosen as logo (brand orb) but may be an AI-agent avatar widget. x012/x013 fall after the event end.
